newsitem.title: USA: Worthington says Ferkany referred to unit.
newsitem.headline: Worthington says Ferkany referred to unit.

text.p: Worthington Industries Inc expects to report improved first quarter, ended August 31, profits, Chief Financial Officer Don Barger said, but Edward A. Ferkany's statement Tuesday that profits were "up significantly over last year" applied to the processed steel operations of the company's Worthington Steel unit.
Ferkany, the unit's group vice president for processed steel, addressed a Salomon Brothers Steel Service Center seminar for institutional investors.
He also told the investors that Worthington Industries sees a 20 percent increase in sales during fiscal 1997.
Sales totaled $1.48 billion in the year ended May 31.
Barger pointed out that $0.05 of last year's $0.24 per share Worthington Industries first quarter earnings came from Rouge Steel, then reported on an equity basis.
On June 1, he noted, the company switched to cost accounting so the Rouge Steel results were not there in the latest quarter.
First Call's consensus estimate is $0.22 per share for Worthington's latest quarter.
